messages:
sam: quick sync — I sketched a small contract for the new reliability dashboard we promised to Console. Goal: show timeouts / 5xx / OOM / degraded-mode entries alongside routing decisions (primary vs fallback) so product can see cause vs effect.

maria: SG. which concrete fields do you need from runtime vs infra?

sam: runtime must emit per-request events with these tags: `request_id`, `route`, `route_variant`, `route_reason` (capacity|quota|latency|policy), `model_variant`, `region`, `customer_tier`, `latency_ms`, `status_code` (200/5xx/timeout/oom/fallback), `cpu_pct`, `mem_rss_mb`, `kv_cache_hit` (0/1). Counters we also want: `timeout_count`, `5xx_count`, `oom_count`, `fallback_count`, `degraded_mode_enter`, `degraded_mode_exit`.

raj: infra side: pls include `node_id`, `gpu_type`, `pool_id`, and `capacity_tier` so we can correlate OOMs to certain machine classes. Also add `ingest_timestamp` (ms).

leah: product asks for two dashboard views: (1) incident triage panel showing top routes causing 5xx/timeouts, (2) rollout safety panel showing fallback rate and degraded-mode rate by rollout. Can we get per-route rolling windows?

sam: yes — we'll emit `route` + `route_variant` and a `route_decision` enum so dashboards can compute fallback_rate = sum(fallback_count)/sum(total_requests) over 5m/1h.

oliver: tiny but important: decide whether `oom_count` is incremental counter or event. For Grafana/BQ we prefer counters for fast rates, but we also want a sample event payload for the trace when an OOM happens. Suggest: emit both — increment `oom_count` and push full trace to `telemetry-traces` topic.

maria: agreed. also, dedupe: some retries generate multiple 5xx events for same logical request. We should include `logical_request_id` so console panels can optionally dedupe.

sam: good call. add `logical_request_id`. Also propose two ingestion paths: high-cardinality event stream (BigQuery) for exploration and summarized metrics (Prometheus/metrics pipeline) for dashboards and SLOs.

sam: example BigQuery schema snippet:```json
{
  "request_id": "string",
  "logical_request_id": "string",
  "route": "string",
  "route_variant": "string",
  "route_reason": "string",
  "status_code": "string",
  "latency_ms": "float",
  "cpu_pct": "float",
  "mem_rss_mb": "int",
  "ingest_timestamp": "timestamp"
}
```

sam: example PromQL (for metrics pipeline):
```
rate(runtime_request_total{status="fallback"}[5m]) / rate(runtime_request_total[5m])
```

raj: how will we tag canary vs stable? suggest `deployment_stage` tag with values `canary/stable/coldstart`. Also `rollout_id`.

leah: product wants alerting triggers: fallback_rate > 5% for 15m on critical routes, 5xx_rate > 1% sustained. Also a safety gate for rollouts: if `degraded_mode_enter` > 0 within 10m of rollout start, auto-halt.

sam: we can implement a webhook from Console to the rollout service to auto-pause. Need infra to expose `degraded_mode_enter` as near-real-time metric (<=30s latency).

oliver: telemetry ops: note cardinality concerns — `route_variant` + `deployment_stage` + `rollout_id` can get large. For the metrics pipeline, we should only keep full cardinality for the event stream. For Prom metrics, we'll limit labels to `route`, `status`, `deployment_stage`, `region`.

maria: acceptance criteria for the API team: 1) events emitted with agreed schema to `events.prod.runtime` topic; 2) Prom metrics `runtime_request_total`, `runtime_request_errors_total`, `runtime_oom_total`, `runtime_degraded_total` available in `telemetry-prod` for queries; 3) sample OOM traces pushed to `telemetry-traces` topic; 4) dashboards panels wired in Console and linked from the rollout page.

raj: timeline? infra can wire the topic consumers and initial dashboards if we get schema by EOD Tue.

sam: I'll post a small PR with schema + enum values in this thread by EOD today.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy: rollout #r-2026 scheduled — monitoring hook registered. :eyes:

leah: thanks — once PR is up I'll review and add product UX notes for the rollout page (safety button, pause/resume, reason dropdown).

oliver: one last ops note: for alerts, prefer burn-rate style (relative to baseline) rather than absolute thresholds for noisy routes.

sam: noted. next steps: I'll publish schema PR, raj will provision consumer, maria will add Prom metric names to the SDK, oliver will draft alert playbook, leah will wire UX copy. target: dashboards live for internal beta next Friday.

maria: ack.

raj: ack.

leah: ack.
